messages:
Diego Morales: Hey team, unboxing my desk kit and the box had a USB-C power brick and a DisplayPort cable, but I need an HDMI adapter for my personal monitor. Shipping list showed "HDMI adapter". Anyone know who handles mismatched shipment items?

Sam (Workspace Ops): Hey Diego, welcome! Sorry about that. We sometimes ship DP instead of HDMI depending on stock. I can swap the adapter for you — are you at desk C9?

Diego Morales: Yep C9. Appreciate it. Do you need the shipping box back or can I just keep the DP cable?

Sam (Workspace Ops): Keep the DP cable, no need to return. I'll bring an HDMI dongle and a spare USB-C cable. ETA 30-45m.

Jordan (IT): FYI Diego, if your monitor supports DP and you have DP->HDMI passive adapters they sometimes don't carry audio. If you need mic/headset passthrough or USB on the monitor, let us know and we'll include an active adapter.

it-bot: Asset ticket ASSET-7903 created: "Swap DP cable -> HDMI dongle for Diego Morales, desk C9." Assigned to Sam (Workspace Ops).

Sam (Workspace Ops): At your desk now — swapped the adapter, left the spare cable. Did a quick test on the monitor, image looks good.

Diego Morales: Thanks Sam! All good now. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jordan (IT): Great, closing loop here. If you hit any display scaling quirks on macOS drop a note and we can help tweak settings. :thumbsup:
